bountyBoardMatrix.roleInvarianceRequirement: Within each named position, both roles use the same footpoint, direction, animation, frame ordinal, WorldSortKey fields except evidence stableId, and expected relation.

cleanMode.description: Committed visual cells are clean: no UI labels, bubbles, or debug overlays inside image areas.

uiOnMode.description: A later UI-on capture must preserve identical world footpoints/sort keys while allowing labels and bubbles outside the sorting contract.

behind.rationale: behind relation is determined by fixedPointY against table anchor Y=379.

boundary.rationale: At Y=379 both keys have fixedPointY=97024; bounty tieBias=-4 sorts before agent tieBias=0, so prop<agent independently of either evidence stableId.

front.rationale: front relation is determined by fixedPointY against table anchor Y=379.

mask58CrossReference.distinction: Drawable bounty-board pixels and their sort spec remain separate from canonical occluder pixels, TMX mask geometry, and hotspot behavior. E8A does not migrate mask 58.

props.tieBiasRationale: At equal fixedPointY, E5 compares tieBias before stableId. bounty-board(-4) < either agent(0), proving table<agent at boundary without relying on an invented or hashed agent stableId.

declarationOrderIndependence.testVector: Sort all five props, then sort deterministic shuffles; every result must equal expectedSequence.

fivePropSortOrder.description: Expected ascending E5 WorldSortKey order after the REJECT-V1 roster-book correction.

globalConstraints.drawableAndOccluderSeparation: These five entries describe drawable props only. Canonical occluder pixels, TMX mask geometry, hotspots, fragments, and navigation remain separate contracts and are not changed by E8A.

failClosedRules.propCompleteness: Anything other than exactly TMX objects 90-94 with unique stableIds fails.
failClosedRules.tmxBinding: Object id/name/type/gid/rect and gid→hall-props firstgid/tile/image source/dimensions must match exactly.
failClosedRules.provenance: TMX, prop, scene-background, manifest, resolver, and role-frame asset hashes must match.
failClosedRules.anchorsAndProbes: Non-finite/out-of-bounds anchors or probes, fixedPoint mismatch, missing directions, or W/E alpha-AABB intersection/guard<4 fail.
failClosedRules.matrix: Anything other than full 8 role-direction and 6 role-depth cells, same-foot role invariance, or boundary prop<agent fails.
failClosedRules.evidence: Anything other than 20 prop cells plus 14 bounty cells with complete metadata and recomputed AABBs/sort order fails.
failClosedRules.generation: generationId must equal SHA-256 of the pretty JSON with generationId replaced by 64 zeroes; SVG generationId/count/cell IDs and freshly generated bytes must match.

rejectionRationale: The prior roster-book anchor treated a detachable book/page region as the drawable; V1 identifies the semantic prop as the full illuminated lectern/cabinet and requires floor/front-base anchor (306,384).
The prior contact sheet did not render actual role frames composited with props and used generic horizontal points instead of scanned alpha-AABB separation.
The prior bounty north matrix point was not frozen at the reviewed world point (1446,351).
visualEvidence.renderingContract: Each clean SVG image area embeds the actual hall background, prop PNG, and decoded idle/down/frame-0 role pixels. Drawables are emitted in ascending E5 WorldSortKey painter order. All annotations are outside image areas.

roleResolver.canonicalResolution: portraitRole first resolves personaCode via normalized portraitRoles slug; lujunyi and husanniang are canonical slugs.

contactSheet.imageAreaPolicy: No labels, speech bubbles, debug overlays, anchors, or AABB boxes inside evidence image areas; metadata is below each image.

generatedBy.sourceEpochSemantics: sourceEpoch is the frozen base commit committer timestamp from git show; no wall-clock generatedAt field is emitted.
